Owen hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Owen borrowed a book about math from the park. The gym is one of the best places in the city. Best of all, the nurse spoke in a gentle voice.
The weather was cloudy that day. Owen and Leo had great fun there. Leo is interested in singing. I visit the dentist twice a year.
Owen's favorite animal is the dog. Owen usually has noodles for breakfast. They took many photos at the swimming pool. Rainy days are not boring at our home.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the gym by bike. There are always many people at the swimming pool. Owen thinks math is interesting but a little difficult.
